FX-GRADE2-001.says: Every setting as added, the new ones written: the drawing exactly as it is.

FX-GRADE2-002.says: Master curve, an S through (64, 40) and (192, 215): darks darker, lights lighter, black and white kept.

FX-GRADE2-003.says: Red curve lifted through (128, 170), blue lowered through (128, 90): warmer midtones, black and white kept.

FX-GRADE2-004.says: Hue versus saturation, one point at saturation 0: every colour its own grey, whatever its hue.

FX-GRADE2-005.says: Hue versus saturation through (0, 100), (120, 200), (240, 100): the greens twice as strong, pure red and pure blue unchanged.

FX-GRADE2-006.says: Hue versus saturation through (30, 150) and (200, 40): the curve runs round through 360 from the second point back to the first; oranges stronger, cyans and blues duller.

FX-GRADE2-007.says: Hue versus saturation, every point at 100: no step, the drawing exactly as it is.

FX-GRADE2-008.says: Shadow wheel hue 195 at 60: the darks teal, the lights untouched.

FX-GRADE2-009.says: Midtone wheel hue 30 at 50 with midtone lightness 20: the middle warmer and lighter, black and white untouched.

FX-GRADE2-010.says: Highlight wheel hue 220 at 40 with highlight lightness -30: the lights cooler and lower, the darks untouched.

FX-GRADE2-011.says: Shadow lightness 40 and highlight lightness -20, no colour: black lifted to 0.2, white lowered to 0.9, greys only.

FX-GRADE2-012.says: Key the reds (hue 0, 20 either side, no softness), secondary saturation 0: red grey, everything else, the skin and orange too, untouched.

FX-GRADE2-013.says: The same key with hue softness 30: hues between 20 and 50 degrees away partly grey, the skin (about 25) and orange (about 33); yellow untouched.

FX-GRADE2-014.says: Key saturation 50 to 100, softness 10, secondary lightness -40: the strong colours darker, greys and the dull tones untouched.

FX-GRADE2-015.says: Key lightness 55 to 100, secondary temperature -50: the light colours cooler, the darks untouched.

FX-GRADE2-016.says: FX-GRADE2-012 inverted: everything but the reds grey.

FX-GRADE2-017.says: FX-GRADE2-013's key shown as the mask: white where the key takes all, black where none, greys between.

FX-GRADE2-018.says: The mask view with no correction set, inverted: the mask still shown.

FX-GRADE2-019.says: Key everything (as added), secondary contrast 60 and tint 30: a second correction over the whole drawing.

FX-GRADE2-020.says: Key the skin (hue 25, 10 either side, softness 20), secondary wheel hue 200 at 70: the skin and warm tones cooled, the rest untouched.

FX-GRADE2-021.says: Key hue 350, 20 either side: the key wraps through 0 and takes red; secondary saturation 0.

FX-GRADE2-022.says: A whole grade: D-397's sections, the master S-curve, a hue curve, the three wheels, a skin key cooled and a dark vignette, each in its order.

FX-GRADE2-023.says: Shadow lightness keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 60 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 untouched, black lifted to 0.15 at frame 2 and 0.3 at frame 4.

FX-GRADE2-024.says: Key hue keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 120 at frame 4, 20 either side, secondary saturation 0: the reds grey at frame 0, the greens at frame 4.

FX-GRADE2-025.says: Wheels and a key moved three pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-GRADE2-026.says: The mask view with a dark vignette: the mask shown, the vignette not drawn over it.
